scripts.dev: bun run dev:client & bun run dev:server
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd client lint && bun run --cwd server lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --cwd client lint:fix && bun run --cwd server lint:fix
scripts.fmt: bun run --cwd client fmt && bun run --cwd server fmt
scripts.fmt:check: bun run --cwd client fmt:check && bun run --cwd server fmt:check
